title: Connected Retail Estate
subtitle: Refrigeration + energy + maintenance → protect stock and service economics

valueIntent.objective: Protect availability, stock integrity and store profitability
valueIntent.baseline: Temperature control policy; no verified avoided-loss baseline
valueIntent.benefitHypothesis: Exposure avoided is not savings; requires actual spoiled-stock and downtime evidence
valueIntent.riskBoundary: Food safety, brand reputation and regulatory reporting
valueIntent.autonomy: L1 recommendation / L2 ticket with approval

agents.name: Signal Steward
agents.mandate: Normalise source events, provenance, freshness and completeness

agents.name: Context & Graph
agents.mandate: Resolve assets, zones, owners, policy context and source conflicts

agents.name: Value Reasoner
agents.mandate: Evaluate materiality, counterfactuals, benefit ownership and confidence

agents.name: Intervention Planner
agents.mandate: Form choices with expected impact, dependencies and failure modes

agents.name: Policy & Risk Gate
agents.mandate: Enforce role permissions, OT safety, privacy, human approval

agents.name: Action Broker
agents.mandate: Issue authorised tickets and controlled commands; handle receipts and rollback

agents.name: Outcome Auditor
agents.mandate: Compare before/after, control for confounders, sign benefits and improve graph

permissions: No refrigeration setpoint or safety override
valueStreams: Mitigate risk · Save money · Protect revenue
partnerRole: Retail FM, refrigeration OEM and service partner
ciscoRole: Secure connectivity, estate observability, Spaces only where relevant

workflow.name: Observe
workflow.description: New source events arrive and are quality checked.
workflow.detail: A sustained temperature excursion coincides with elevated compressor demand and previous service issues.

workflow.name: Contextualise
workflow.description: Join physical, operational and business context.
workflow.detail: A sustained temperature excursion coincides with elevated compressor demand and previous service issues.

workflow.name: Hypothesise
workflow.detail: An early inspection may reduce spoilage exposure and unnecessary energy consumption.

workflow.name: Plan
workflow.description: Compare interventions, cost, confidence and risk.
workflow.detail: Raise a priority investigation with temperature evidence and duty manager escalation; do not remotely override refrigeration safety limits.

workflow.name: Guard
workflow.description: Apply the delegated authority and safety boundaries.
workflow.detail: Food safety dominates energy optimisation. Store manager and FM escalation; no automatic refrigeration changes.

workflow.name: Approve
workflow.description: The accountable human accepts or rejects the proposed action.

workflow.name: Act
workflow.description: Create authorised workflow actions with audit and rollback.
workflow.detail: Create a SIMULATED priority work order and notify store operations; no refrigeration controls are written.

workflow.name: Verify
workflow.description: Check pre/post data and counterfactual validity.
workflow.detail: Confirm product disposition by food-safety owner, repair outcome, temperature normalisation and avoided recurrence.

workflow.name: Learn
workflow.description: Publish verified evidence, or record unresolved gaps.
workflow.detail: Create a verified fault-pattern playbook and estimate value only from reviewed loss/energy data.

outcome.baseline: Temperature control policy; no verified avoided-loss baseline
outcome.benefitHypothesis: Exposure avoided is not savings; requires actual spoiled-stock and downtime evidence
outcome.verification: Confirm product disposition by food-safety owner, repair outcome, temperature normalisation and avoided recurrence.

controls.riskNotes: Food safety, brand reputation and regulatory reporting
